proposals.title: Give Each Share an Equal Vote
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a recapitalization plan giving one vote per share for all outstanding stock, phasing out Class B disproportionate voting rights.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: Independent Board Chairperson
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy requiring the Board Chair, whenever possible, to be an independent director, amending bylaws as necessary.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: Directors to be Elected by Majority Vote
proposals.topic_summary: Requests amending articles or bylaws so directors are elected by majority of votes cast, with plurality retained for contested elections.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: True Diversity Board Policy
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy to disclose board nominee minimum qualifications and each nominee's skills, ideological perspectives and experience in a matrix.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: A Content Governance Report
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report evaluating strategies and policies on content governance, including human rights, democracy, freedom of expression and related risks.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: Median Gender Pay Gap
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on the company's global median gender pay gap and associated policy, reputational, competitive and operational risks.
proposals.evidence: our board of directors recommends that our stockholders vote against this proposal.

proposals.title: Workforce Diversity
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a diversity report on programs supporting employees with differing political ideology, public policy effects on work environment, and outreach to conservative think tanks.
proposals.evidence: our board of directors believes that the preparation of the report contemplated by this proposal is unnecessary and not beneficial to our stockholders.

proposals.title: Strategic Alternatives
proposals.topic_summary: Requests retaining advisors to study strategic alternatives and an independent committee to evaluate them to maximize shareholder value.
proposals.evidence: Therefore, our board of directors believes that the process contemplated by this proposal is unnecessary and recommends that our stockholders vote against this proposal.
